active.en-US: Whether to show the animated loading effect.

children.zh-CN: 加载结束后显示的内容，`loading` 为 `false` 时原样渲染，不包外层元素。
children.en-US: Content shown once `loading` is `false`, rendered as is without a wrapper element.

className.zh-CN: 占位根元素的类名，`loading` 为 `false` 时不渲染占位根元素，因此不生效。
className.en-US: Class name of the placeholder root element. It has no effect once `loading` is `false`, since no root element is rendered.

loading.zh-CN: 为 `true` 时显示 `placeholder`，反之显示子内容。
loading.en-US: When `true`, `placeholder` is shown. Otherwise the children are shown.

placeholder.zh-CN: 加载等待时的占位元素。

ref.zh-CN: 占位根 `div` 的引用，`loading` 为 `false` 时不挂载。
ref.en-US: Reference to the placeholder root `div`. It is not attached once `loading` is `false`.

style.zh-CN: 占位根元素的样式，`loading` 为 `false` 时不生效。
style.en-US: Style of the placeholder root element. It has no effect once `loading` is `false`.

className.en-US: Class name of the avatar placeholder.

shape.zh-CN: 占位头像的形状，可选 `circle` 或 `square`，未设置时为 `circle`。
shape.en-US: Shape of the avatar placeholder: `circle` or `square`. Defaults to `circle`.

size.zh-CN: 占位头像的大小，可选 `extra-extra-small`、`extra-small`、`small`、`medium`、`large` 或 `extra-large`，未设置时为 `medium`。
size.en-US: Size of the avatar placeholder: `extra-extra-small`, `extra-small`, `small`, `medium`, `large` or `extra-large`. Defaults to `medium`.

type.zh-CN: 替换占位块自带的类型，同时决定它的类名；不为 `avatar` 时 `size`、`shape` 不生效。
type.en-US: Replaces the type of the block, which also names its class. Unless it is `avatar`, `size` and `shape` have no effect.

className.en-US: Class name of the image placeholder.

type.zh-CN: 替换占位块自带的类型，同时决定它的类名。
type.en-US: Replaces the type of the block, which also names its class.

className.en-US: Class name of the title placeholder.

type.zh-CN: 替换占位块自带的类型，同时决定它的类名。
type.en-US: Replaces the type of the block, which also names its class.

className.en-US: Class name of the button placeholder.

type.zh-CN: 替换占位块自带的类型，同时决定它的类名。
type.en-US: Replaces the type of the block, which also names its class.

ref.zh-CN: 占位段落根元素 `ul` 的引用。
ref.en-US: Reference to the root `ul` element of the paragraph placeholder.

rows.zh-CN: 占位段落的行数，每行渲染为一个 `li`。
rows.en-US: Number of rows in the placeholder paragraph, each rendered as an `li`.
